user.title: MAST water meter
user.description: Sign in at [mast.co.il](https://www.mast.co.il). In the site's browser console, run `copy(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user')||'{}').token)` and paste the result into Session renewal token. Leave JWT token empty; Home Assistant obtains it automatically. Chrome and Firefox may ask you to type `allow pasting` before pasting the snippet into the console. You can also provide a JWT instead.

data.token: JWT token (optional with session renewal token)

card.title: Choose your water card
card.description: Pick the water meter card to import. If your cards could not be listed automatically, type the card number.

webhook.title: Token push URL (optional)
webhook.description:
To send the JWT and session renewal token to Home Assistant automatically, install the userscript from the README and give it one of these URLs. Treat the URL as a secret: anyone who has it can push a token (it is only accepted if it works for your card).

Same network as Home Assistant:
`{internal_url}`

From anywhere:
`{external_url}`

You can show these again later via the integration's menu → Reconfigure.

reconfigure.title: Automatic renewal and token push
reconfigure.description:
To enable automatic renewal, paste the remembered-login token from MAST (see the README). Leave it blank to keep the current credentials. The userscript can also send it automatically using one of these URLs. Treat the URLs as secrets.

Same network as Home Assistant:
`{internal_url}`

From anywhere:
`{external_url}`

reauth_confirm.title: MAST session needs sign-in
reauth_confirm.description: MAST could not renew this session. Sign in at [mast.co.il](https://www.mast.co.il). In the site's browser console, run `copy(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user')||'{}').token)` and paste the result into Session renewal token. Chrome and Firefox may ask you to type `allow pasting` before pasting the snippet. You can also paste a fresh JWT or use the optional userscript.

data.token: JWT token (optional with session renewal token)

error.missing_credentials: Enter a session renewal token or a JWT.
error.invalid_token: That does not look like a JWT token.
error.token_expired: That JWT has expired. Add a session renewal token or copy a fresh JWT.
error.invalid_card: MAST returned an error. Check the card number.
error.no_data: The request worked but returned no readings.
error.invalid_user_token: MAST rejected the session renewal token or it cannot access this water card.

abort.already_configured: This water card is already configured.
